source_title: Centrus Begins Shipping Centrifuges to Ohio to Support Major Expansion of Uranium Enrichment Capacity
source_excerpt:
Milestone connects Tennessee manufacturing with Ohio uranium enrichment expansion to rebuild America's nuclear fuel supply chain
Achievement marks the assembly of a complete, unobligated supply chain to serve both the commercial and national security markets
OAK RIDGE, Tenn. , Oct. 29, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Centrus Energy's (NYSE: LEU ) Oak Ridge manufacturing plant has completed and is shipping the first new centrifuge today as part of the company's multibillion-dollar expansion of its uranium enrichment capacity. This milestone marks the next phase of the project where completed centrifuges manufactured in Tennessee will be shipped to Ohio for final assembly, with the manufacturing rate growing over time. It also reflects that Centrus has now secured a complete and complex manufacturing supply chain. Both milestones were achieved ahead of Centrus' previously-announced year-end target.
" Completing the first new centrifuge for our expansion and standing up a one-of-a-kind supply chain are significant moments for our team and this country," said Amir Vexler, President and Chief Executive Officer of Centrus. "Building this unique manufacturing capability at scale takes specialized expertise, time, precision and sustained commitment. These milestones demonstrate our ability to translate our investment into tangible progress and position us to re-establish this country's rightful position in the global enrichment market."
Centrus' technology is fully licensed, proven and de-risked, with more than four million machine-hours of successful operation. Its existing centrifuge cascade in Ohio includes components manufactured in 2019, as well as components the company manufactured in prior years, and has been reliably producing High-Assay, Low-Enriched Uranium (HALEU) since late 2023. In December 2025, Centrus restarted centrifuge manufacturing activities in Oak Ridge to support a major expansion of its uranium enrichment capacity in Ohio. In January 2026, the company announced a $560 million investment to expand and modernize its Oak Ridge Technology and Manufacturing Center, transitioning it to a high-rate manufacturing plant capable of supporting production of thousands of advanced centrifuges.
More recently, Centrus has been manufacturing thousands of individual centrifuge components while steadily expanding manufacturing capacity and throughput. Concurrently, it has contracted a network of domestic suppliers and ordered tens of thousands of parts from American manufacturers to secure an unobligated supply chain that can service both commercial and national security demand. Earlier this month, Centrus completed its strategic acquisition of Westerman Holdings, a key supplier of centrifuge casings and other major components, as the company expands and further secures its supply chain.
The new centrifuges produced in Tennessee will be grouped into cascades, with the first new capacity expected to come online in Ohio in 2029 as previously announced. This is part of the company's multibillion-dollar expansion of uranium enrichment capacity. This expansion includes large-scale production of LEU for the existing reactor fleet for baseload electricity, HALEU for next generation reactors, and enrichment for national security needs.
Centrus' Oak Ridge facility is the only advanced centrifuge manufacturing plant in the United States with a proven and de-risked technology. All other centrifuge technologies in commercial operation today are manufactured exclusively overseas. Centrus relies on an exclusively domestic supply chain, which allows its centrifuges to produce enriched uranium for both commercial and national security applications. Today's shipment marks a tangible step in connecting this American-made centrifuge technology with re-established and expanded domestic uranium enrichment capacity.
Centrus Energy is a trusted American supplier of nuclear fuel and services for the nuclear power industry, helping meet the growing need for clean, affordable, carbon-free energy. Since 1998, the company has provided its utility customers with more than 1,850 reactor-years of fuel, equivalent to more than 7 billion tons of coal. With world-class technical and engineering capabilities, Centrus is pioneering production of High-Assay, Low-Enriched Uranium and is leading the effort to restore America's uranium enrichment capabilities at scale so that we can meet our clean energy, energy security, and national security needs. Find out more at www.centrusenergy.com or follow us on LinkedIn and X .
